text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Going to the cafeteria to take a 
breather, I spotted Hokko Tarumae."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... These haskap berries are 
delicious... ...It might have been a while 
since I've just leisurely savored 
something...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I miss the harvest festivals... Everyone 
eating until their bellies were full... 
Basking in the sun together... *sigh*...
choice_data_list: Are you feeling tired, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
N-No! I'm full of energy! I'm just feeling 
a little nostalgic, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she says that, her expression 
remains gloomy. Fatigue from running in 
consecutive races seems to have caught up 
with her, so I should reconsider our 
upcoming schedule...
